blocking: Hard-rule violation: Latin body text explicitly uses TT Ramillas Regular and Italic rather than Bold.
Reduced-motion users and visitors without GSAP cannot operate the desktop celebrations accordion: its event handlers are below the motion-only early return.
The looping hero video has no pause control and continues playing with reduced motion enabled.

fixes.where: assets/css/site.css — font definitions, body, eyebrow and italic styles
fixes.what: Use the supplied TT Ramillas Bold face and weight 700 throughout Latin text; remove Regular/Italic overrides that violate the required typography.
fixes.why: The current implementation breaks an explicit launch requirement.

fixes.where: assets/js/site.js — accordion initialization after if (!motion) return
fixes.what: Initialize accordion interaction before the motion guard. Add panel IDs and aria-controls; hide collapsed desktop content accessibly, and expose all mobile cards without misleading collapsed states.
fixes.why: Essential interaction must survive reduced motion and unavailable animation libraries.

fixes.where: index.html — hero video; assets/js/site.js — video IntersectionObserver
fixes.what: Add a visible, keyboard-accessible pause/play button outside the logo area. Default to the poster for reduced motion and prevent the observer from overriding a user's pause.
fixes.why: Continuous autoplay needs a stop mechanism, and the current observer ignores motion preferences.

fixes.where: assets/js/site.js — scrollToEl and same-page anchor handler; assets/css/site.css — anchor targets
fixes.what: Add header-sized scroll-margin-top to section targets and main. Move focus to the destination after intercepted keyboard navigation, using tabindex="-1" where necessary.
fixes.why: The native fallback ignores the fixed header, and the intercepted skip link scrolls without reliably transferring focus.

fixes.what: Keep the vertical nine-stop layout until all nine labels fit their columns; use a measured wider breakpoint instead of switching at 768px.
fixes.why: Nine narrow columns cannot reliably accommodate labels such as Consultation at tablet widths.

fixes.where: index.html — inquiry form; assets/js/site.js — form submission
fixes.what: Add pending, success and failure states with an accessible status region; preserve entered values on failure and restore the submit button for retry.
fixes.why: Native field validation exists, but the site provides no submission feedback or recoverable error handling; this is independent of the approved placeholder endpoint.
